remarks: Seize the opportunity to make this stylish 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence your new home. The conveniences surrounding the Playhouse Condominiums' premier location near lively downtown Westport and Compo Beach cannot be overstated. Just a short walk to shops, restaurants, cafes, parks, entertainment, and the library, this area offers an exceptional lifestyle. Upon entering, you are greeted by a bright and inviting living/dining area with scenic park views, highlighted by a vaulted ceiling and a charming wood-burning fireplace. In the heart of the unit is the exquisite kitchen that is a chef's delight, featuring premium stainless-steel appliances and custom cabinetry, merging style with practicality. Adjacent to the main living area is a generously sized secondary bedroom with a spacious closet and easy access to a beautifully renovated full bathroom. On the upper level, a generously sized primary suite with two closets (walk-in and reach-in), as well as a newly remodeled, luxurious bathroom complete with a full shower, elegant cabinetry, and dual sinks. A private deck off the primary suite is an ideal space to enjoy tranquil moments and views of the landscaped grounds and mature trees. This unit includes the added benefit of a private underground garage with two side-by-side parking spaces, plus additional guest parking for convenience. The residence is also available fully furnished for $5,000 per month, making this an exceptional opportunity to experience refined living.
